summary: Iteration 5 (both). Backend: 29/29 pytest tests pass. Extended backend_test.py to cover the NEW logs response shape ({items,total,counts}), pagination (skip/limit non-overlap), category filter (all/file/conn), delete_logs by date range (harmless 2000-01-01..02 -> deleted=0), delete_logs admin-only (401 unauth + 403 non-admin), GET /api/settings PUBLIC, PUT /api/settings admin-only (401 unauth + 403 non-admin), PUT /api/settings persists & is reflected on next GET (then restored to defaults). Also patched two pre-existing tests to accept null storage_name in logs (new 'settings_updated' log has none). Frontend playwright (desktop 1440x900 + mobile 390x844) validated: (1) Login screen renders configured app name + tagline from /api/settings and document.title == app name. (2) Sidebar admin order is exactly Dashboard, File Browser, List Storage, Logs Activity, Manage App, Manage User (testids in order). (3) Dashboard shows dashboard-recent-activity + dashboard-view-all-logs link, and getting-started card is NOT present (count=0). (4) List Storage page shows getting-started card. (5) Logs page: table has <=25 rows on first page, logs-range shows '1-25 of 55', Prev disabled on page 1, Next advances and page 2 rows are fully distinct from page 1 (0 overlap). (6) Clear Logs dialog opens, accepts 2000-01-01/2000-01-02, confirm triggers DELETE /api/logs, toast contains 'Deleted 0 logs' text, list refreshes without wiping real logs. (7) Manage App: edit app_name+tagline, live Preview reflects change, Save persists -> sidebar brand and document.title update to the new name; then restored defaults (app_name/tagline/meta/primary_color=#2563eb/favicon=''/logo=''). (8) Regression: regular (non-admin) user lands on /files, and manual navigation to /settings, /logs, /storages, /users all redirect back to /files. (9) Mobile viewport (390px): Manage App and Logs pages scrollWidth == 390 (no horizontal overflow); logs table has its own overflow-x-auto container. All TEST_* data cleaned up. Settings restored to defaults at end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py log_activity with storage_doc={_id:'',name:None,type:None} for settings_updated stores storage_name=null in Mongo — any consumer that assumes storage_name is a string must guard for null (frontend Logs.jsx already renders '—' when falsy; backend tests were updated to guard). Suggest a dedicated log_system_event(action, detail) helper to keep the schema clean instead of a synthetic storage doc.

DELETE /api/logs uses timestamp comparison with a stringly typed ISO field. Since timestamps are stored as ISO8601 strings with the same offset (+00:00), $gte/$lte string comparison works, but it silently breaks if a future writer uses a different tz suffix. Consider storing timestamps as native BSON dates or normalizing to UTC 'Z' consistently.

GET /api/logs computes counts (all/file/conn/reconnect) via 3 additional count_documents on every request, even when only paginating within the same filter. For high log volumes consider caching or a single aggregation pipeline. Non-blocking for MVP.

GET /api/settings is public and returns the raw stored document (minus _id). If any future field could contain sensitive data (e.g. an API key), it would leak — treat the settings collection as strictly non-secret.
Logs.jsx: `total` computed in component (line ~83) is unused (data.total is used everywhere in JSX). Dead variable — harmless.
seed_data_creation: Transient TEST_* storages and users created by pytest + one temp non-admin user via playwright for redirect regression — all cleaned up. Settings were flipped to 'Nexus TEST Rename' during UI test and then restored to defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GET /api/logs now returns {items,total,counts:{all,file,conn,reconnect}} — do NOT expect a list. Pagination params: skip, limit (max 100, default 25); category in {all,file,conn}. DELETE /api/logs?start=YYYY-MM-DD&end=YYYY-MM-DD (admin only). GET /api/settings PUBLIC, PUT /api/settings admin only. Frontend testids added this iteration: nav-manage-app, dashboard-recent-activity, dashboard-view-all-logs, getting-started, save-settings-button, settings-app-name/tagline/meta-description/favicon-url/logo-url/primary-color, logs-range, logs-prev, logs-next, open-delete-logs, delete-logs-dialog, delete-logs-start/end, confirm-delete-logs. Sidebar admin order (top->bottom) is dashboard,files,storages,logs,manage-app,users. When restoring settings via UI, use dispatchEvent for the color input (native color input needs input+change events). pytest.ini uses -n 2 which introduces small races on log counts — new tests handle this by asserting bounds rather than exact equality.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only test-suite races caused by parallel workers on shared log collection were fixed (tests now tolerate concurrent inserts).
